steps.zh: 装上唯一的 bun 可执行文件
steps.code: curl -fsSL https://bun.com/install | bash · npm install -g bun

steps.en: In your existing Node project, install dependencies with Bun
steps.zh: 在现有 Node 项目里用 Bun 装依赖

steps.en: Reads package.json, fills node_modules from a global cache and writes bun.lock
steps.zh: 读 package.json，从全局缓存装好依赖，写出 bun.lock

steps.en: Run the TypeScript entry file directly, no build step
steps.zh: 直接运行 TypeScript 入口文件，不先编译

steps.en: Transpiles TS/JSX on load and runs it on JavaScriptCore
steps.zh: 加载时转译 TS/JSX，在 JavaScriptCore 上运行

steps.en: Run the test suite with the built-in runner
Finds the test files and runs them with a Jest-compatible API
steps.zh: 找到测试文件，用兼容 Jest 的 API 跑完

value.en: One binary stands in for node, npm, ts-node and Jest in the daily loop, each step noticeably faster
value.zh: 日常开发里一个二进制顶掉 node、npm、ts-node 和 Jest，每一步都更快

sources: https://github.com/oven-sh/bun README (install script, npm install -g bun, bun run index.tsx, bun test, bun install)
https://bun.com/docs/pm/lockfile (bun install creates a lockfile called bun.lock)
